identitySignals: OUSD's own agreement titles for 2022-2024 name Bay Area Women Against Rape (BAWAR) and the 2024-2026 ones name BRAVE Bay Area for the same department, consistent with the 2024 rename reported by news outlets
ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer lists Bay Area Women Against Rape, a 501(c)(3) in Oakland, CA, matching the agenda location

KQED describes BRAVE Bay Area as a 54-year-old Alameda County rape crisis and survivor-support organization, matching OUSD's 'Student health, support & family services' and 'Human Trafficking Prevention' funding category
research.notes: Organization reportedly closed at end of September 2025 (per news coverage). The organization's own website (bawar.org) could not be fetched (self-signed certificate error), so website and contact details are left null. The BRAVE Bay Area / Bay Area Women Against Rape link rests on OUSD's own agreement titles and search-result snippets from Oaklandside, KQED and SFGate (formerly known as Bay Area Women Against Rape). Legal name per ProPublica may predate the BRAVE rename.

profile.summary: A nonprofit in Oakland, California, that provided counseling, a 24/7 helpline and advocate training for survivors of gender-based violence, serving the region for over 54 years. It operated under the name BRAVE Bay Area. News reports say it planned to close in September 2025.

sources.title: Bay Area Women Against Rape - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica
BRAVE Bay Area, Nation's First Rape Crisis Center, to Shut Down After 54 Years

review.notes: KQED confirms BRAVE Bay Area was formerly Bay Area Women Against Rape (counseling, 24/7 helpline, advocate training, 54+ years, closing September 2025), and OUSD's own agreement titles switch from BAWAR to BRAVE Bay Area for the same department. ProPublica confirms the Oakland 501(c)(3) with EIN 94-2300454; the summary is neutral and supported.
